verdicts.reason: Wirex is a UK-based crypto/payments platform with millions of consumer users (top traffic countries include UK), raised $27.8M (within $2M-$250M range), is a fintech/payments/crypto-wallet business rather than a verification vendor, runs high-volume digital onboarding where identity verification is embedded (Wirex One transfer flow references identity confirmation), and launched the new consumer app Wirex One in 2026-05 which requires new user signup/verification, satisfying the recency requirement.

ZBD is a licensed payments/PSP company for games with total funding of $86.5M (within range) and is not itself a verification/compliance vendor. However, its customers are primarily game studios/publishers rather than direct consumer or SMB end-users in the UK/Ireland/US/Canada, there is no evidence its own signup flow drives high-volume revenue-enabling identity checks, and no qualifying recent trigger (new license/go-live, user complaints, new consumer product needing verification, age-gated exposure, or a funding round within 120 days—the Series C was announced 2026-01-22, more than 120 days before 2026-09-06) is established.
